disposition: Preserve the failed rehearsal. Re-run seal and validation with stdout/stderr outside the workspace. Existing REG-0009 already requires manifest-last/no-post-seal-mutation behavior, so no duplicate regression is added.
observation: The first v0.08 package rehearsal produced two manifest mismatches immediately after sealing.
root_cause: Shell redirection created the destination file before seal-package enumerated workspace contents, then command stdout mutated that already-hashed file after the manifest was written.
title: Package rehearsal stdout was redirected into the workspace being sealed
